findings.title: Include job-root stdout/stderr in the same aggregate backup cap
findings.problem: used_bytes scans backup destination and job/results only. Retained dispatcher source writes combined phase stdout/stderr at the job root, outside results. Declared job-output footprint can therefore exceed total cap while budget accepts.

evidence.referenceDispatcherBehavior: retained local dispatcher redirects stdout and stderr to job-root phase.private.log outside results
evidence.boundaries: Tiny own files, original used_bytes/budget, modeled disk space; no server/PG/real backup/data/source copy

findings.minimumCorrection: Original T45 confirms exact current runner output layout without expanding backup scope, then counts its task-owned stdout/stderr/control outputs in the same cap with deduplication and necessary bounded reserve. Do not lower disk floor, create a backup framework or delete old artifacts.
findings.limits: Tiny own-file reproduction only; no actual production byte overrun, backup or restore is demonstrated.

reusableSourceScope.targetGuard: Exact three existing service identities, image/birth/restart, config source hash and fixed database physical/local noninteractive socket identity precede destination creation and data dump. New mismatch gates exercised offline; current live identities not established.
reusableSourceScope.readOnlyScope: Original single-database read-only dump/custom format/noninteractive authentication, offline TOC without restore destination and original opaque app/web/media/config/image paths remain; no input/credential data emitted to report.
reusableSourceScope.caps: Declared4GiB aggregate; dump2GiB, images1GiB, each app/web/media256MiB, config/TOC16MiB; initial12GiB, floor8GiB,128KiB bounded control reserve within cap; stream checks before writes and drains fast-child pipes. F01 is incomplete aggregate path coverage.
reusableSourceScope.childAndTime: Original whole900s and child timeouts retained; original bounded own child-group stop, private partials preserved; no old service/container/backup mutations. BusyBox timeout form is adopted from prior verified parameter contract.
reusableSourceScope.reportPrivacy: Only safe hashes, synthetic byte sizes and conclusions retained. Private source not copied into report/Git; no real business rows, credential or connection string included.

next: Original T45 fixes only aggregate output coverage in exact private successor, retaining all accepted checks/bounds; C schedules after active PG window settles. Recheck only F01 plus affected control reserve/floor seam; no full7 rerun or real backup/restore by QB.
